contractCoverage.obligation: Fresh install creates an owner-only (0700) data root and blob directory; ensure is the sole layout creator and chmods after mkdir so umask cannot widen
Default data root is ~/.nipo-science under home, never under Documents/Desktop implicit sync paths; guide discloses the location
contractCoverage.notes: Enforced by DEFAULT_ROOT constant + guide copy; no runtime re-check if an operator overrides resolve_paths into a synced tree (override is a test seam, not a product flag).

contractCoverage.obligation: Listening socket is 127.0.0.1; require_loopback/bind_loopback refuse every non-loopback host including wildcard, IPv6 any, private, and padded literals
No public parameter, env var, or flag accepts a non-loopback bind; hostile HOST-shaped env vars cannot widen bind
Cross-origin state-changing request to the local interface is 403 cross_origin_denied with zero durable side effects

adversarialCases.title: Pre-fix write_token_file parent-mkdir under umask 0 leaves group/other-readable root
adversarialCases.method: Probe-local recreation of removed path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) path only; no product mutation / no git stash of api.py
adversarialCases.detail: Under umask 0o000 the legacy mkdir produced a root with group and other bits set (not 0700), proving the guarded gap is real and mutation-capable. Current product write_token_file refuses missing parent instead.

adversarialCases.title: start_local_api with read-only parent fails closed with no partial root
adversarialCases.method: Parent chmod 0500; start_local_api on child root; assert OSError and empty parent
adversarialCases.detail: ensure cannot create the root under a non-writable parent; no partial directory remains.

adversarialCases.title: ensure then chmod 0755 then start_local_api repairs root to 0700
adversarialCases.detail: start_local_api re-enters ensure and repairs a widened root before publishing the token.

adversarialCases.title: First-run guide disclosures present; 격리/sandbox/confine absent in guide block
adversarialCases.method: Source-slice renderFirstRunGuide body; require ~/.nipo-science, 루프백, in_process, Keychain; forbid sandbox/격리/confine/confinement
adversarialCases.detail: Guide block is honest. Note (non-blocking): other app.js surfaces use the word 격리 in residual-disclosure copy (e.g. '격리 없음'); those are outside the first-run guide contract and still refuse sandbox claims.

adversarialCases.title: Hostile HOST-shaped env sweep beyond named-test list still cannot widen bind
adversarialCases.method: Set UVICORN_HOST, SERVER_HOST, BIND_ADDR, FASTAPI_HOST, ASGI_HOST, NIPO_ALLOW_REMOTE, etc. to wildcard; bind_loopback/start_local_api with 0.0.0.0/::/192.0.2.1 raise NonLoopbackBindError; control 127.0.0.1 still binds
adversarialCases.detail: Bind path ignores env entirely; only the explicit host argument is considered and non-loopback is refused.
